item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Build Knowledge Graphs with AI pipeline in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now offers a public preview of an AI pipeline that builds knowledge graphs from PostgreSQL data. The feature uses AI to extract entities, relationships, and properties from source data and construct a queryable graph.

  • Source: Azure Updates
